visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A middle-aged man with dark hair, wearing a red and black training jersey labeled 'SPARKLE TRAINING' and blue batting gloves, stands on a red mat in the center of a professional baseball stadium. He holds a wooden baseball bat and smiles broadly at the camera while squinting his eyes. The background features empty blue stadium seating and a large black batting cage net structure. (2) The man shifts his posture into a batting stance. He begins swinging the bat repeatedly at baseballs tossed from an off-screen source. The camera cuts rapidly between side-view medium shots and close-ups of his torso as he makes contact with several balls. A woman in a white t-shirt and jeans stands behind the net holding a smartphone to record him. (3) After completing his swings, the man walks across the grass toward the camera, looking physically exhausted. He has a slight smile but is breathing visibly. He carries the bat in one hand, showing tattoos on both forearms. The stadium's bright afternoon sun casts sharp shadows on the field, and advertising banners for brands like Maxxis and Brothers are visible in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking casually in a low pitch, greeting someone with a friendly tone. A high-tempo rock background track featuring distorted electric guitar riffs and a steady drum beat fades in quickly. (2) Sharp percussive sounds of a wooden bat striking a baseball occur at irregular intervals, synchronized with the rhythmic rock BGM. Faint chatter and occasional laughter from a small group are heard in the ambient background. (3) The man speaks again, his voice now noticeably breathier with slightly higher vocal arousal, indicating physical exertion. The rock music continues until it is cut sharply at the end of the clip, replaced by the natural sound of outdoor stadium wind floor.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase professional Taiwanese baseball player Lin Chih-sheng practicing his swing in a stadium setting, blending athletic performance with a humorous, casual look at the physical toll of high-intensity training.
